atoms.exact_source_text: Route               | Longitudinal path, edge choice, cover line, infrastructure, elevation, and known obstructions.
atoms.normalized_claim: Route state covers longitudinal path, edge choice, cover line, infrastructure, elevation, and known obstructions.

atoms.exact_source_text: Time / Light        | Day visibly drains; later conditions alter traffic, weather, predators, visibility, and safe return.
atoms.normalized_claim: Time/Light state: day visibly drains over time.

atoms.exact_source_text: later conditions alter traffic, weather, predators, visibility, and safe return
atoms.normalized_claim: Later time conditions alter traffic, weather, predators, visibility, and safe return.

atoms.exact_source_text: Load                | Cargo affects speed, Crossing burden, available hands, and willingness to press farther.
atoms.normalized_claim: Load state: cargo affects speed, Crossing burden, available hands, and willingness to press farther.

atoms.exact_source_text: Weather / Condition | Wind, rain, heat, cold, spume, road work, and sudden acoustic spikes alter travel terms.
atoms.normalized_claim: Weather/Condition state: wind, rain, heat, cold, spume, road work, and sudden acoustic spikes alter travel terms.

atoms.exact_source_text: Known shelter       | Home, Staging Posts, Held Reaches, natural refuges, and temporary safe stops define achievable range.
atoms.normalized_claim: Known shelter state: Home, Staging Posts, Held Reaches, natural refuges, and temporary safe stops define achievable range.

atoms.exact_source_text: Party condition     | Wounds, fear, Exposure, cohesion, hunger, separation, and who is carrying what.
atoms.normalized_claim: Party condition state includes wounds, fear, Exposure, cohesion, hunger, separation, and who is carrying what.

atoms.exact_source_text: Node knowledge      | Unknown, sighted, studied, depleted, renewable, contested, claimed, marked, or transformed.
atoms.normalized_claim: Node knowledge state can be unknown, sighted, studied, depleted, renewable, contested, claimed, marked, or transformed.

atoms.exact_source_text: The road-edge route is richer and more interrupted; the wall-edge route is quieter and slower.
atoms.normalized_claim: The road-edge route is richer and more interrupted while the wall-edge route is quieter and slower.

atoms.exact_source_text: Terrain changes the price and consequence of actions without becoming a positional combat grid.
atoms.normalized_claim: Terrain changes the price and consequence of actions without becoming a positional combat grid.

atoms.exact_source_text: A route is not “best” in the abstract; it is the kind of day the party chooses.
atoms.normalized_claim: A route is not objectively best; it represents the kind of day the party chooses.

atoms.exact_source_text: After Launch, TRAVEL may begin on the Home Reach as the party walks toward a chosen edge.
atoms.normalized_claim: After Launch, TRAVEL may begin on the Home Reach as the party walks toward a chosen edge.

atoms.exact_source_text: This is already Away Mode because the party—not the Colony—is the crunch subject.
atoms.normalized_claim: Home Reach travel is already Away Mode because the party, not the Colony, is the crunch subject.

atoms.exact_source_text: Early campaigns may still meet local contest or opportunity;
atoms.normalized_claim: Early campaigns may still meet local contest or opportunity on the Home Reach.

atoms.exact_source_text: mature Home ground should increasingly become a quiet, familiar departure walk.
atoms.normalized_claim: Mature Home ground should increasingly become a quiet, familiar departure walk.

atoms.exact_source_text: The player may choose to return whenever the party can still plausibly reach a safe stop.
atoms.normalized_claim: The player may choose to return whenever the party can still plausibly reach a safe stop.

atoms.exact_source_text: The game should continuously communicate the cost of one more Node, one more Reach, or one more attempt.
atoms.normalized_claim: The game should continuously communicate the cost of one more Node, one more Reach, or one more attempt.

atoms.exact_source_text: Withdrawal preserves future lives and is not automatically graded as failure.
atoms.normalized_claim: Withdrawal preserves future lives and is not automatically graded as failure.

atoms.exact_source_text: A Node is a meaningful place anchored in Field geography.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Node is a meaningful place anchored in Field geography.

atoms.exact_source_text: Passing a known Node remains TRAVEL.
atoms.normalized_claim: Passing a known Node remains TRAVEL.

atoms.exact_source_text: Entering it, working it, claiming it, studying it, or confronting what occupies it opens MEET.
atoms.normalized_claim: Entering, working, claiming, studying, or confronting what occupies a Node opens MEET.
